contradictions.description: The 2026-06-30 AP aging totals $30,777.73, while the trial balance reports Accounts Payable of $38,216.65, leaving an unexplained $7,438.92 difference. This equals the unpaid remainder of opening AP reflected in the ledger but omitted from the aging. The discrepancy does not prevent completion of the four requested tasks.

w29-accrual_schedule.reason: The prior prepaid schedule and contracts define the prepaid population, additions, amortization convention, and monthly amounts, while the GL establishes that June amortization has not yet been booked.

w29-bank_rec.reason: The bank statement, cash ledger, and trial balance provide sufficient amounts and references to identify outstanding checks, the deposit in transit, and unrecorded bank fees and interest, and to derive a unique adjusted cash balance.

w29-journal_entries.reason: The payroll register, prepaid contracts and schedule, fixed asset register, bill documents, and GL provide sufficient support to identify the missing payroll accrual, combined prepaid amortization, depreciation, and required vendor-bill reclassification without duplication.

w29-variance_analysis.reason: June budget amounts and as-closed actuals can be derived from the budget, GL, and supported close entries. Selection of material variances requires ordinary professional judgment but does not make the task unsolvable.
